verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs confirm a PR-based code review workflow with online browsing and commenting (gitea-docs-3, gitea-docs-12), and CI/CD integrations like Actions/Drone/Jenkins could theoretically post checks, but there is no evidence of large-diff handling optimizations or third-party code-quality report rendering (e.g., SonarQube/Codecov annotations) inside the review screen. missing for 10: large-diff viewer optimizations, third-party code quality report display in PR review UI, any integration example showing this in practice.
